name: auth-flow-team-invite
title: Auth Flow Team Invite
description: An invite acceptance that starts from a ticket with the inviter and member stack, creates the account with the email already verified, then turns into a token field for inviting teammates. Emails become chips with a role switch and an External tag, a seat meter fills as you add people, and sent chips fly into the member stack.
author: Hyperblur <hello@hyperblur.dev>
